activities.name: Keraton Yogyakarta Palace Tour
activities.description: The living royal palace of the Sultan of Yogyakarta — occupied since 1755 and still the political and spiritual heart of the city. Gamelan performances in the inner courtyard, Javanese wayang shadow-puppet museums, and the Sultan's collection of colonial gifts. Mon–Sat 08:30–14:00.

activities.name: Candi Prambanan
activities.description: The largest Hindu temple complex in Southeast Asia — three 47m towers dedicated to Shiva, Brahma, and Vishnu, built in the 9th century. UNESCO World Heritage Site. The Ramayana ballet is performed at the outdoor amphitheatre on full-moon nights.

activities.name: Borobudur Sunrise
activities.description: The world's largest Buddhist monument — a 9th-century stupa with 2,672 relief panels and 504 Buddha statues across nine platforms. The sunrise ticket (4:30am access) grants you the monument in mist before the crowds arrive. 40km from Yogyakarta.

activities.name: Taman Sari Water Castle
activities.description: The Sultan's 18th-century pleasure grounds — bathing pools, underground tunnels, and a royal mosque hidden inside Yogyakarta's kampung. The bathing pavilions (Umbul Binangun) are the centrepiece: three tiled pools surrounded by stone colonnades.

activities.name: Malioboro Shopping Walk
activities.description: The most famous street in Java — 1.5km of batik shops, leather goods, silver jewellery, and wayang puppet stalls lining both sides. Bargain directly with vendors; prices are open to negotiation. Best from 10am to dusk.

activities.name: Pasar Beringharjo Traditional Market
activities.description: Yogyakarta's oldest and largest traditional market (1758) — three floors of batik fabric, jamu herbs, snacks, antiques, and sarongs. The ground floor is a sensory onslaught of colour and fragrance. Best between 7–10am.

activities.name: Gudeg Yu Djum
activities.description: Yogyakarta's defining dish — jackfruit slow-cooked in coconut milk and palm sugar until mahogany-dark, served with opor ayam and sambal krecek. Yu Djum's shop on Wijilan has operated since 1950 and sells out by 9am. Come early.

activities.name: Bale Raos — Royal Javanese Cuisine
activities.description: The only restaurant in Indonesia serving the authentic royal cuisine of the Yogyakarta Sultanate — dishes from the Keraton's own historical recipe manuscripts. Set inside the palace complex. Dinner reservation strongly recommended.

activities.name: Angkringan Lik Man Night Cart
activities.description: The original angkringan — a street food cart that spawned thousands. Nasi kucing (cat-portion rice with sambal), kopi joss (coffee with charcoal), and various skewers for under Rp20,000. Opposite the railway station from 5pm.

activities.name: Grand Inna Malioboro
activities.description: The colonial-era hotel directly on Jalan Malioboro — originally built as Hotel Toegoe in 1908. The Heritage Wing rooms face the street with original teak floors; the pool pavilion overlooks a garden courtyard. 234 rooms total.

activities.name: Phoenix Hotel Yogyakarta
activities.description: A restored 1918 Dutch colonial mansion converted to a 144-room hotel two blocks from Malioboro. The heritage building's original terrazzo floors and whitewashed colonnades are intact. Rooftop pool overlooking the old city roofline.

activities.name: Malioboro Night Walk
activities.description: After 8pm the street vendors pack up and buskers take over — gamelan musicians, kroncong guitar players, and wayang golek puppet performers. The becak (cycle rickshaw) rides between Malioboro and Alun-Alun Kidul are the most pleasant way to see the city at night.

activities.name: Alun-Alun Kidul Lantern Ride
activities.description: The palace's southern ceremonial square fills every night with becak pedalo frames covered in LED lights. The game: ride a blindfolded pedalo between the two sacred banyan trees — local lore says the blindfolded succeed only if their hearts are pure.

activities.name: Mount Merapi Sunrise Trek
activities.description: A pre-dawn 4-hour hike to the rim of Indonesia's most active volcano (2,930m). Guides are mandatory and check current alert status — hikes are suspended above Alert Level 1. Views of the glowing lava dome and sunrise over Java are extraordinary.

activities.name: Batik Making Workshop
activities.description: A 2-hour hands-on session at a Malioboro workshop where you apply wax resist and dye to produce your own batik cloth. Yogyakarta is the epicentre of Indonesian batik (UNESCO Intangible Heritage). Sessions run daily; results can be taken home.
